LESSON: EARTHQUAKES

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: GEOGRAPHY
Strand: Natural Systems and Processes
Topic 2.4: Earthquakes
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Earthquakes, part of Natural Systems and Processes in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 GEOGRAPHY.

Key inquiry question: Why are earthquakes of concern to humans?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Brainstorm on the meaning, types and causes of earthquakes in the world and share in class., Learners with speech difficulties could use Alternative and Augmentative modes of Communication-AAC or be allowed extra time to express their views,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Brainstorm on the meaning, types and causes of earthquakes in the world and share in class., Learners with speech difficulties could use Alternative and Augmentative modes of Communication-AAC or be allowed extra time to express their views,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Earthquakes together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital Literacy: The skill of interacting with technology as the learner watches video clips on the effects of

earthquakes on the environment.

● Creativity and Imagination: The skill of making connections is enhanced as learners draw world maps showing

the distribution of earthquake zones and display in class.

● Learning to Learn: The skill is enhanced as learners brainstorm on the meaning, types and causes of

earthquakes in the world and share in class.

● Communication and Collaboration: The skill is enhanced as learners engage with a resource person on disaster

management and preparedness strategies and take notes.

Values:
● Unity: Learner displays team spirit as they brainstorm on the meaning, types and causes of earthquakes in the

world

● Respect: Learner displays etiquette as they interact with a resource person on disaster preparedness and

management strategies

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Environmental Education: Learner watches video clips on the effects of earthquakes on the environment and takes

notes

● Self-Esteem: Learner draws world maps showing the distribution of earthquake zones

● Safety and Security: Learners engage with a resource person on disaster management and preparedness strategies

and take notes.

● First Aid: Learners engage with a resource person on disaster management and preparedness strategies and take

notes.

41

Suggested Learning Resources:

Photographs, pictures, local and extended environment, maps, resource persons, plain papers, manilla papers, digital

resources, charts and marker pens, approved text books and other printed resources ,library resources, whiteboards,
